text: To create a user-friendly and accessible interface for this music streaming service, we will design a clean, intuitive layout that prioritizes ease of navigation and social connectivity. The interface will feature a prominent "Discover" tab with algorithmic recommendations and curated playlists, a dedicated "Playlists" section for easy creation and sharing, and a "Concerts" tab displaying upcoming dates for followed artists. Social features will be integrated via a "Friends" feed, showing real-time listening activity and shared playlists. To enhance the aesthetic and modern feel of the application, the window frames and decorative panels will be crafted from transparent acrylic, allowing the vibrant album art and dynamic backgrounds to shine through while maintaining a sleek, minimalist look.
